[Intro]
[D]
[Em]
[Bm]
The story starts

[Verse 1]
[D]laying in the dark
[Em]with someone new
[Bm]
I’m feeling tired
[D]from all the time
[Em]I spent on you
[Bm]
But I know I’m strong
[D]from all the tro-
[Em]uble I’ve been through
[Bm]
The story starts
[D]where the story falls
[Em]apart with you
[Bm]

[Pre-Chorus]
[G]Don’t lie,
[D]bright eyes
[A]Is it me that you see
[Bm]when you fall asleep? 'Cause I
[G]know it’s
[D]you I
[A]dream about every night
[Bm]Giving me a feeling like

[Chorus]
[G]Love
[D]in the summer
[Bm]Way I’ve never felt
[A]with another
[G]Don’t lie,
[D]bright eyes
[A]Is it me that you see?
Tell me I’m not dreaming alone
The story starts

[Verse 2]
[D]lying in the dark
[Em]broken and bruised
[Bm]
I count the scars
[D]left in my heart
[Em]from losing you
[Bm]
And I was wrong
[D]but let’s be ho-
[Em]nest you were too
[Bm]
I miss the part
[D]where I was fal-
[Em]ling hard for you
[Bm]
So

[D]bright eyes
[A]Is it me that you see?

[Interlude]
[G]I can’t take
[A]back the things I said
[Bm]And I won’t
[Em]say that I regret
[D]Any day
[A]that I was
[G]yours
[D]Don’t lie,
bright eyes
Is it me that you see
when you fall asleep? 'Cause I
know it’s
